ridge: equal user/equal present class weights; only four source training users fit mean/scale/intercept/weights
selection: validation next source user maxmacro then min onehotMSE then largerlambda; held source user finaldiagnostic only
bank: Seeded 14 of 84 length9 zero-sum kernels, three +2 and six -1; 8 random range channels averaged per kernel; common bank across views/signals/folds. Original and first difference; valid dilation1,3,9.
inputs: Prepared legacy channels0 and2, each radar separately; no cross-radar temporal products; no new normalization.
bias: For each of36 blocks and14kernels choose one source-training sample uniformly with replacement from sorted training IDs, seed20261004. Quantiles .2,.4,.5,.6,.8 of its valid convolution response. Fit on four training users only.
pool: At median bias: proportion strictly above; mean positive excess (C-b) or0; mean positive position/(length-1) or-1; exact longest consecutive strictly positive run/length. Equal threshold resets run.
temporal_null: Same four statistics after deterministic sampleID/responseLength/seed permutation, common order for equal lengths and all kernels; same trained biases; PPV/mean-excess unchanged.
comparators: Existing energy-area cnn_readout and old source tailCNN predictions with identical splits, labels and artifact SHA checks; not used to select any candidate.
limits: Source users3..8 already repeatedly used; exploratory six-fold development screen, not untouched test or eight-fold confirmation.
Known response-pooling baseline, NOT original contribution or exact MultiRocket replication.
Small fixed504 response bank, not default author50k features; failures do not refute MultiRocket.
